INITIATIVES:
• Effluent Discharge Analysis for waste
water was done in March 2017 and the
respective licenses issued.
• We collected a total of 2,360 kilograms
under the Electronic & Hazardous
waste disposal programme.
• Noise Level and Air Quality surveys
were carried out during the year and
reports disseminated as appropriate.
• Environmental Impact Assessments
for infrastructural projects were carried
out and all projects licensed.
• Waste segregation was conducted as
per new PaTaMu standards.
• Each Plant has been provided with
a minimum of 20,000 liters storage
capacity for rain water harvesting.
Plans are underway to roll out at
Ennsvalley.
• Statutory Environmental Audits are
due in December 2017.

• With the exception of Nakuru Feeds,
all Plants were audited in August
2015 as per the 3 year statutory
requirement; Nakuru Feeds was
audited in January 2017. The next
audit will be done in 2018/2020.
• The Eldoret & Nakuru Feeds plants
were recognised for their participation
in the Energy Management Awards.
• Lighting motion sensors were installed
at Nairobi Feeds.
• Energy saving bulbs were installed at
all our sites.
